questions.question: Where did Moses' mother hide him as a baby?
options: In a hidden storeroom of Pharaoh's great palace
In a basket among the reeds of the Nile
In a cave in the eastern hills
In a grain field outside the city
questions.answer: In a basket among the reeds of the Nile
